Developed by Bui Quang Minh, Thomas Wong, Nhan Ly-Trong, Huaiyan Ren
Contributed by Lam-Tung Nguyen, Dominik Schrempf, Chris Bielow,
Olga Chernomor, Michael Woodhams, Diep Thi Hoang, Heiko Schmidt
interpretation: Unfiltered IQ-TREE symmetry diagnostics on original paired masks; both alphabets treated as 20-state characters. No marker selection, hypothesis conclusion or multiplicity calibration. Nominal p-values and counts can be affected by sparse contingency tables, missingness and correlated/contextual 3Di characters. Non-rejection does not establish model adequacy.
